objective: Add internal note on slack telling about dispute

inputParams.paramDescription:
write an internal note for AR team format exactly as:                                                                                                                            
"DISPUTE — {requester_name} ({requester_email}) has disputed invoice(s)
totaling ${invoice_amount}.                                                                                                                   
Customer reply: [first 200 characters of ticket_latest_comment]"

please dont add any other text
